# Sites Pro

> Sites Pro (SIA SitesPro) is a Latvia-based digital agency building product-grade
> websites, web platforms and AI automations for clients across the EU and worldwide.
> Working languages: English, Russian. Contact: info@sitespro.org

## What we do

- **Website development** — https://www.sitespro.org/services/web — high-performance
  marketing, corporate and content websites built with Next.js, React and headless or
  WordPress CMS. Core Web Vitals, accessibility and search visibility built in.
- **Web platform development** — https://www.sitespro.org/services/web-platforms —
  custom web applications, dashboards and internal tools. React/Next.js frontends,
  Node.js APIs, PostgreSQL/MySQL/Redis data layers, integrations, cloud and CI/CD.
- **AI & automations** — https://www.sitespro.org/services/ai — AI chatbots and
  assistants, OpenAI and Anthropic API integration, RAG pipelines and vector
  databases, n8n/Zapier and custom workflow automation, document processing.
- **Digital consulting** — https://www.sitespro.org/services/consulting — payment
  systems (Stripe, PayPal, Square, custom gateways), fintech architecture and
  compliance, technology selection, technical audits and roadmaps.

## Selected work

- **Liquid Silk** — interactive WebGL gallery of fourteen pointer-reactive shader scenes
  with generative Web Audio, one dependency-free HTML file. Live: https://crcknaka.github.io/liquid-silk/
  Case study: https://www.sitespro.org/portfolio/liquid-silk
- **White-label payment gateway** — prototype of a payment orchestration core for a fintech
  client: merchant API, payment state machine, double-entry ledger, cascading acquirer
  routing, settlements with rolling reserve, zero-JavaScript hosted checkout. Case study:
  https://www.sitespro.org/portfolio/payment-gateway
- **Vadi** (https://vadi.lv) — our own accounting SaaS for Latvian sole traders and
  small companies: tax calendar with calculated amounts, payroll with full gross-to-net
  breakdown, VID EDS XML declarations, bank statement matching and eight free tax
  calculators. Case study: https://www.sitespro.org/portfolio/vadi

## How we work

Discovery & strategy → design & build → test, launch & scale. Agile delivery with
regular updates and client involvement at every stage. Typical engagement starts with
a free consultation and a tailored proposal covering scope, timeline and pricing.

Commercial terms: 50% deposit to start, remainder on completion; milestone-based
payments for larger projects. Cards, PayPal, SEPA and crypto accepted. Ongoing
maintenance packages cover security updates, content changes, performance monitoring
and technical support.

## Technologies

Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, WordPress and WooCommerce, headless CMS,
PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, vector databases, n8n,
Stripe and other payment providers, cloud hosting with CI/CD and observability.
